title: Consumer Dispute
description: Definition of Consumer Dispute under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: a dispute where the person against whom a complaint has been made, denies or disputes the allegations contained in the complaint
content.plain_language: a disagreement between a consumer and a seller or service provider where the seller or service provider rejects or argues against the consumer's complaints
examples: a customer complains about a defective product and the manufacturer denies any fault
a consumer disputes a bill from a service provider, claiming it is incorrect
non_examples: a customer asks for a refund due to a change of mind
a consumer and a seller agree on a resolution without disputing the complaint

user_queries: how is a consumer dispute defined
what happens when a consumer disputes a complaint
